posts.title: Obiter Scripta, no. 170
posts.description: I feel well only when writing. Happy and at home in my thoughts, I then forget all that is disagreeable in life, and all life’s sufferings. I need stop only for a few days instantly to become unwell, overwhelmed and troubled: my head feels heavy and burdened. So powerful an urge, so ample, so inexhaustible, […]

posts.title: Construction, Reconstruction
posts.description: Living beings build to last (this is proved by plants). Durability means building up; life is construction, reconstruction. Rebuilding indefatigably.
